definitions.gloss: low altitude; low in the sky
definitions.explanation: A position relatively close to the ground. Used for aircraft, flying objects, and figuratively for performing at a minimal level.

examples.japanese: {低空|ていくう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
⟦ヘリコプター→ヘリコプター：05117_herikoputaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{低空|ていくう}{飛行|ひこう}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A helicopter was flying at low altitude.

examples.japanese: {今学期|こんがっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{低空|ていくう}{飛行|ひこう}だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、なん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{単位|たんい}→単位：03412_tani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{取|と}れた→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: My grades this semester were just barely scraping by, but I managed to earn my credits.

notes:
{低空|ていくう} means low altitude — close to the ground. Most commonly encountered in the compound {低空|ていくう}{飛行|ひこう}.

FORMS:
⟦{低|てい}→低〜：03961_tei⟧ (low) + ⟦{空|くう}→空〜：03949_kuu⟧ (sky/air)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {低空|ていくう}{飛行|ひこう} (low-altitude flight)
- {低空|ていくう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ (to fly low)
- {低空|ていくう}⟦{侵入|しんにゅう}→侵入：11440_shinnyuu⟧ (low-altitude intrusion)

USAGE:
{低空|ていくう}{飛行|ひこう} is widely used figuratively to mean "barely scraping by" or "performing at the minimum acceptable level." Example: ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{低空|ていくう}{飛行|ひこう}だ (grades are just barely passing).

SIMILAR WORDS:
{高空|こうくう} (high altitude).
